title: Chapter 963
text:
"Two blueprints, two abilities, one talent …"

Looking at the five rewards that he had drawn, Han Xiao fell into deep thought.

Among the abilities that he had drawn this time, the one with the highest value was clearly the [Innate Mechanical Soul] growth talent. With his current level, it could provide him with a total of 220% Machinery Affinity and 150% Virtual Technology bonus. It was an Advanced Mechanic talent.

As for the other four options, [Apostle Grade Machinery Affinity] was impossible to choose. Although [Army Firepower Volley] was not bad, it was not cost-effective. The two blueprints were very high-level, but he had similar equipment, so he did not really need them.

"The results are not bad." Han Xiao was quite satisfied.

Since they were both Mechanics, most of their skills were compatible with each other. This meant that the range of skills they could draw was much higher than other classes. Mechanics were known for having a lot of skills, and for a Mechanic of Manison's level, who knew how many blueprints he knew. Being able to draw an Advanced Mechanic Talent from such a large number of blueprints was already a huge stroke of luck.

Manison's strength came from the accumulation of talents. Only with a large number of talents could there be a qualitative change. Although he did not draw a top-notch Molding Talent, he had obtained a high-level Mecha Empire talent, which closed the gap between them.

The wool came from the sheep's back. The more abilities that he drew from Manison, the smaller the advantage that Manison had over him. The gap between them would be closed step by step. Facing someone like Manison, who was full of high-level talents, it was very difficult for him to become a fatty in one bite.

The level 300 [Innate Mechanical Soul] Machinery Affinity bonus was higher than [Lord Grade Machinery Affinity], and the Virtual Technology bonus was even better. Together with the 2.5x coefficient of [Virtual Lord], it was equivalent to a 375% Virtual Technology bonus. All in all, the total effect was about the same as a core class talent like [Machinery Emperor].

You have received [Innate Mechanical Soul]!

It was as if a beam of light had pierced through his brain. The theoretical structure in his brain underwent a subtle change, and he gained a new understanding of Machinery Technology.

After adapting to the changes, Han Xiao exhaled.

"Not only does Manison have [Perfect Mechanical Sense], but he also has [Innate Mechanical Soul] and a series of other Mechanic talents. This guy's talent is too good."

To be honest, he was a little … ahem, very envious!

Han Xiao then looked at the Manison Character Summon Card that he had drawn this time. This Character Summon Card's effects were even stronger. It gave him + 20% INT, + 10% MYS, and + 2 to all skill levels. It was not a mechanical ability but an ability called [The Ancient Ones].

'I wonder if this ability requires me to join The Ancients, or if I just need to stay low for a long time …'

More than seventy billion EXP was more than double the reward from the Tyrant's Quest. It replenished his dwindling EXP reserves.

However, this mission did not give him any Legendary Points. Looking at the name of the mission, Han Xiao had some guesses. The mission title specifically emphasized 'Virtual Battle', so perhaps only an official battle would give him Legendary Points.

After looking at the new ability for a while, Han Xiao closed the interface and thought about the gains and losses this time.

"Manison came all of a sudden this time and came prepared. He stole some data and even made me spend a Perfect Mechanical Sense Character Summon Card. If not for the two new abilities, it would have been a huge loss. Manison suppressed me in terms of his abilities, achieved his goal, and alarmed the dynasty. Thus, it is unlikely that he will cause any more trouble in the short term."

Han Xiao's eyes turned.

He had been showing off a little too much recently, and this was a good opportunity for him to take back some of the limelight.

His foundation was still too weak, and he needed to develop it properly. Before the chives returned, he needed to loosen the soil and increase the fertility of the soil.

Losing a Perfect Mechanical Sense Character Summon Card was not a big problem. Han Xiao had quite a few blank Character Summon Cards in his inventory. Some were obtained from the Random Rewards, and some were from the [Flickering World] mission. He only needed to find a time to use them on Reynold or Nero and copy another [Perfect Mechanical Sense].

Speaking of which, he had accumulated quite a few Random Reward chances recently, and he could find a time to draw them consecutively to see if he could get anything good.

Hmm, I should wait until Fu Ding and Nero are together. One can neutralize my bad luck, and the other can provide me with good luck.

In the eyes of the Great Mechanic Han, Feidin and Nero were like two door gods on his left and right.

After summing up his losses, Han Xiao stood up, opened the army's internal network, and wrote a simple internal statement.

"Comrades of the Black Star Corps,

"Not long ago, the artificial intelligence center of the headquarters was invaded by the Mecha Empire's Manison. With the help of all the members and the dynasty, we successfully forced Manison to retreat. During this period, there were various disturbances in the internal network, but they have all been successfully resolved.

"I do not wish to become enemies with the Mecha Empire, but reality does not change according to one's will. What happened today is a signal for everyone to be mentally prepared to face the Mecha Empire one day.

"The Black Star Corps has been established for more than twenty years, and it has grown from a mercenary group with a weak foundation to the leading armed group in the Star Field today. Such an achievement cannot be separated from the contributions of everyone. In these twenty years, we have been through all kinds of ups and downs together, and we have encountered all kinds of difficulties and obstacles. This is a road that is destined to not be smooth, and there are many more obstacles ahead for us to overcome.

"The universe is vast, but no matter how vast it is, it cannot accommodate endless ambition. As long as there are intelligent species, competition is an eternal melody. It was like this in the past, today, and in the future.

"In the past, I have created many miracles, and in the future, I will not be afraid of competition. I hope that everyone will work hard with me.

"Your Army Commander, Black Star.

Galaxy Calendar, Year 710, 11th of September. "

Seeing that there were no problems, Han Xiao made some slight changes and sent it out to inform all the members.

The intention of this move was to calm the restless hearts of the army, boost morale, and weaken the negative impact of Manison's actions. Although he did not need to care about what the majority of the members thought, it was better to do something than not to do anything.

After dealing with this matter, Han Xiao swallowed a few nutrition pastes and returned to his room to rest for a while. He then returned to the machinery modification room and continued to build and strengthen the machinery.

After realizing the difference in strength between the Mecha Empire and himself, Han Xiao's passion for improving his foundation grew. Therefore, during this period, he planned to go into seclusion to build and guard the headquarters to prevent Manison from making a comeback … although the possibility of this was not high.

After confirming that the storm was over, he planned to go to the Flickering World and personally control the development of the machinery civilization and the Black Spirit Race.

…

In the Sea of Star Spirits, the Limitless Financial Group headquarters …

In the huge pure white office, Sorokin was multitasking and checking the business reports from various places when his communicator suddenly rang.

When he was working, the communicator would set the communication priority. Only important people with high priority would be able to contact him directly.

Sorokin put down the financial report in his hands and picked up the communicator. On the screen was Manison, who had completed the infiltration.

"Your Excellency Mecha Empire, did you succeed?"

"Hmm, Black Star's Virtual Technology is not weak. The dynasty sent Kant over, so I only obtained a portion of the information you wanted. I have already sent it to you," Manison said calmly.

Looking at the data sent by Manison, Sorokin shook his head.

"This internal information is of some help to me, but it's not considered confidential … Forget it, this kind of thing cannot be forced. Speaking of which, why did you contact my main body directly? Just send the information to my doppelganger in the Bloodshed Land. "

"Just being cautious."

Manison's tone was casual. He was very experienced and did not want to transmit data within the Shattered Star Ring to eliminate the possibility of being intercepted by Black Star.

Dealing with Black Star this time was just a routine thing for him to consolidate his position. Other than becoming more and more interested in Black Star, Manison did not feel anything else.

"Alright." Sorokin nodded. "You defeated Black Star this time and have already formed a grudge with him. Aren't you afraid that Black Star will take action?"

"If he's not convinced, I don't mind defeating him a few more times."

"Heh, Black Star is not your opponent now, but that might not be the case in the future. Don't forget about his terrifying potential …"

Manison glanced at him calmly. "Keep your thoughts to yourself."

Sorokin smiled playfully and changed the topic.

"By the way, last month's dividends have been calculated and will be distributed in a few days. What resources do you need to purchase? Give me a list, and I will exchange them for you directly."

"Same as usual."

Manison did not mind. Although the dividends of the financial group were generous, at his level, he did not care about money.

After chatting for a while, the two of them hung up.

Putting down the communicator, Sorokin's eyes flickered slightly.

"Mecha Empire … Black Star …"

…

Central Galaxy, Red Empire mother planet, Ruler's Office.

A virtual screen floated in front of Uranril. The dynasty's main artificial intelligence, 'Heroic Soul', displayed the internal announcement that Han Xiao had just made.

After reading it, Uranril nodded lightly.

"It seems like Black Star understood our intentions and did not overreact."

[Dark Emperor] Clottey crossed his arms and said calmly, "Black Star is a Super genius that has never appeared in history. Normally, geniuses are very arrogant. He has been showing off recently, but he was able to quickly recognize reality. This mentality is not bad."

Even the Red Empire, which was known for its stubbornness, knew how to endure. Black Star had displayed shocking potential, and while the dynasty was pleasantly surprised, they were also worried that Black Star would break easily. However, from the looks of it, Black Star was still very clear-headed and did not fight to the death with the Mecha Empire.

The dynasty also knew that the Mecha Empire was not to be trifled with. In terms of status, combat power, and influence, Manison's level was even higher than the old dragon and Kant. He was the number one ally of the Radiant Federation, an existence on the same level as EsGod. Only the super fighter of the dynasty, the Dark Emperor, could barely be compared to Manison.

To choose a number one Beyond Grade A from each of the three Universal Civilizations, the Radiant Federation's trump card was' Mecha Empire 'Manison, the Red Empire's trump card was' Dark Emperor 'Clottey, and the Arcane Church's trump card was' Void Overlord 'Kasuyi.

The three Universal Civilizations considered problems from the perspective of the entire civilization. If it was not necessary, they would not easily involve their civilization in a battle between Beyond Grade As. Therefore, regarding the sparring between Beyond Grade As, as long as no lives were lost or the authority of the civilization was challenged, the three Universal Civilizations would always adopt a tacit attitude to maintain the balance. After all, they could not completely restrict the daily activities of their allies.

Kant's remote projection was also in the room. Shaking his leaf, he sighed and said, "Although that's the case, Manison has been the main god of the Machinery Faith for far too long."

"This can't be helped. It's not just happening to the Mechanics. Even the experts of the Arcane Church who play with the gods are helpless." Clottey snorted coldly. "Even if we can kill all the believers of the Machinery Faith, faith itself cannot be killed. It will only eliminate the possibility of the Machinery Faith worshipping the dynasty's Mechanics forever."

Uranril tapped the table. "There's no need to say these words. After this incident, Black Star might have some complaints about the dynasty and need to be comforted."

"Why don't we give him some blueprints? There's nothing better than high-level blueprints to comfort the wounded little heart of a Mechanic," Kant said irresponsibly.

Kant said irresponsibly. He glanced at Clotti, who was full of pretentiousness, and suddenly became interested. He activated his talent, and his carrot-like body quickly turned into Clotti's appearance, exactly the same.

"Don't turn into me."

Clottey frowned unhappily. He could not be bothered to look at Kant and turned to face Uranril, slowly saying, "Kant, Milizaus, and I will all pass away sooner or later. Black Star is the next Beyond Grade A pillar of the dynasty and needs to shoulder the heavy responsibility of guarding the dynasty. He has already proven that he can be of great use. I suggest we be bolder in supporting him with resources."

"Hmm …"

Uranril pinched her smooth white chin and fell into deep thought.

…

In the galactic era, the efficiency of information dissemination was extremely high. The virtual battle between the Mecha Empire and Black Star in the Shattered Star Ring quickly spread like wildfire.

Many galactic residents had a new topic to talk about, but in terms of influence, it was not as big as the battle between Black Star and the Tyrant.

Because virtual battles were not as popular as Beyond Grade As fighting each other, there was no restricted footage, so the influence of this event was naturally not that big.

Although it was rumored that Black Star had suffered a defeat, in the eyes of most people, this was not a big deal. The name of the Mecha Empire was deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, and it was not strange that Black Star had lost to the strongest Mechanic. After all, there were many people who had lost to the Mecha Empire in history.

The various galactic organizations did not care about the result. Instead, they paid attention to the conflict between the Mecha Empire and Black Star, and quite a number of them were secretly delighted.

Sisko was one of the examples. The stronger the opponent Black Star provoked, the happier he was. Being targeted by four Beyond Grade As in the Shattered Star Ring who were on the side of the Mecha Empire, he was currently living an extremely low-profile life.

The impact of this event in the outside world was not that big, but in the Mechanic circle, the impact was not small. Black Star was a new Divine Throne Mechanic, and the Mecha Empire was a veteran big shot. Both of them received a lot of attention. In the end, when the two of them clashed, the Mecha Empire did not lose any of its glory in the past. He suppressed the younger generation who wanted to challenge him, proving that he was still the ferocious person he was in the past.

After this battle, in the eyes of most Mechanics, there were still only two types of Mechanics in the world. One was the Mecha Empire, and the other was the other Mechanics.

Han Xiao did not care about the rumors in the galaxy. Regardless of whether Manison made a profit or not, he did not lose out.

Furthermore, reducing the attention of outsiders was in line with his idea of keeping a low profile. In the short term, Han Xiao did not have any plans to challenge the Mecha Empire's position.

After all, he was different from the Tyrant. He rarely did things that were beyond his capabilities.

The logic of being a player was deeply ingrained in his bones.

What if I can't beat the boss? Level up first! Otherwise, what else can I do?

After staying in the headquarters for more than half a month and confirming that the Mecha Empire would not cause trouble again, Han Xiao gathered a fleet and set off for the Flickering World. He went to the countryside to inspect the territory.
